tools.name: calculate_esim_data_usage
tools.description: Calculate daily and total gigabyte (GB) data consumption for international travel based on trip duration, map navigation, video streaming, social media, and hotspot tethering.

tools.name: check_device_esim_support
tools.description: Check whether a specific smartphone or tablet model supports digital eSIM, including hardware differences between US eSIM-only models, mainland China dual physical SIM models, and Japanese/European variants.

tools.name: recommend_travel_esim_plan
tools.description: Recommend the optimal travel eSIM plan tier (Daily High-Speed Reset vs Total Data Bucket vs True Unlimited) for 180+ global travel destinations with local tier-1 carrier coverage.

tools.name: lookup_esim_regional_coverage
tools.description: Resolve regional travel eSIM bundles (Europe 33, Southeast Asia 8, Latin America, North America, Global) to determine included countries, border-crossing roaming handoffs, and shared GB pools.

tools.name: get_esim_installation_guide
tools.description: Provide step-by-step QR code scanning, manual SM-DP+ Address / Activation Code entry, and Data Roaming switch settings for iOS (Settings -> Cellular) and Android (Settings -> Network).

tools.name: compare_travel_esim_pricing
tools.description: Benchmark standard fair market prices per Gigabyte (USD/GB) across Japan, USA, Europe, Southeast Asia, and worldwide to evaluate prepaid eSIM value.
